messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Little Crown?
messages.body:
Hi,

Following up on Jake Essex for the Little Crown. He does the 50s and 60s properly (Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis and more), own PA, no deposit.

It's £300 cash for two one hour sets, or £250 a night if you book four dates. Saturdays suit him best, so if one works in the coming months, reply here and I'll send over free dates.

If it's a no, just say so and I'll leave you alone.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
